snippet.title: "Nestify Cozy Design" - Build & Decorate Cozy Rooms | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
✔️Steam Demo Available Now
✔️Steam Festival of Houses and Dwellings: Mar 30 - Apr 6

Welcome to "Nestify: Cozy Design", a relaxing cozy interior design sandbox game where creativity meets comfort.
Design your own rooms from scratch: draw room layouts, place furniture, customize objects, and experiment with colors, lighting, scale, and rotation.

Create your perfect cozy space, set the mood with relaxing music and weather, and build interiors that feel warm and personal. Whether you love room decorating games, cozy games, or interior design, Nestify lets you design your own little sanctuary. What kind of cozy room would you design first?

Try the Free Demo
Wishlist the game on Steam to support development:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4403350/Nestify_Cozy_Design/ 

Features
✨ Draw and shape your own room layouts
✨ Place and customize furniture
✨ Adjust colors, lighting, scale, and rotation
✨ Paint walls, floors, and ceilings
✨ Create relaxing atmospheres with music and weather
✨ Enjoy a calm, creative sandbox experience

Time codes
0:00 - Place objects
0:03 - Change the size
0:14 - Change furniture color
0:27 - Flip object
0:31 - Paint floor, ceiling and walls
0:38 - Shape the room
0:43 - Choose music

Join our social media and Discord community to be up to the latest news. 
And Wishlist us on Steam pls, we would be very grateful.
